questions.question_english: A particle of mass 'm' is subject to two forces, Fx = 2 2 y -mω x;F = -mω y in two mutually perpendicular directions. It obeys the initial condition: dy x = = 0 dt . Had the forces acted individually, each would have led to SHMs of unequal amplitudes. (The symbols have their usual meanings). What would be trajectory of the resultant motion of the particle?
questions.question_hindi: 'स्' द्रव्यमान का एक कण दो बलों के अधीन है, र्इे ृ – स्ω२र् े ; इब् ृ – स्ω२ ब् दो परस्पर लंबवत दिशांए है। यह प्रारंभिक स्थिति: ० ृर् ्ब् े ृ ्ू का पालन करता है। अगर बलों ने अकेले कार्य ही किया होता, तो प्रत्येक का असमान आयाम का एस.एच.एम. होता। (प्रतीकों का उनका स्वाभाविक अर्थ है)। कण की परिणामी गति का प्रक्षेपवक क्या होगा?
questions.explanation_english: Given, The force in the x-direction is, Fx = –mω2x and Fy = –mω2y, is in the y direction Both of the particles have the same angular frequency ω and are proportional to position of the particle in their respective direction. • In S.H.M, the trajectory of the particle depends on the ratio of amplitudes of the motion in the x and y direction. If the ratio of the amplitudes is not equal to 1, the trajectory will be an ellipse. If the ratio of the amplitudes is equal to 1. The trajectory will be a circle. • Since the force in this case would have led to S.H.M. of unequal amplitude, the ratio of the amplitude is not equal to 1 (especially less than 1). • Therefore, the trajectory of the resultant motion of the particle will be an ellipse. So option (a) is right.

(i) For the point (2, 1) and (3, 2)- Work done, W = ∆V = Change in Potential Energy W = V1–V2 From the equation 1st, For point (2, 1) in equation (i) we get V(2, 1) = 4–2+1 = 3 For point (3, 2) V(3, 2) = 9–6+4 = 7 Work done, W = V(3, 2) – V(3, 1) = 7–3 W = 4 Joule

Peltier discovered that when current is made to flow through a circuit consisting of two different types of conductors, a heating or cooling effect is observed at the junctions between the two materials this change in temperature at the junction is called the Peltier effect. When electric current is passed through a circuit consisting of two different conductors, a cooling effect is observed in one junction wheareas another junction experience a rise in temperature. This effect is reversible in nature and heating or cooling effect observed at a junction can be reversed by changing the direction of the current flow. Peltier effect is used for cooling computes and other electronic equipment.

questions.explanation_english: If the points in an electric field are all at the same electric potential, they are known as the equipotential points, on a surface collectively called as equipotential surface. • Electric field is always perpendicular to equipotential surface. • Two-equipotential surfaces can never intersect each other. • For a point charge, the equipotential surfaces are concentric spherical shells. • For a uniform electric field, the equipotential surfaces are planes normal to the X-axis. • For an electric dipole, equipotential surface is the plane perpendicularly bisecting the line joining the charges. • In a uniform electric field, any plane normal to the field directions an equipotential surface. • E ∝ 1 dr or E = dV – dr • For an infinitely long linear charge, equipotential surface are cylindrical.

questions.explanation_english: When a rod is moving in a magnetic field then an e.m.f is generated across its ends. The e.m.f is given by e.m.f generated = BlVsinθ. • When a metal rod of length 'l' is placed normal to a uniform magnetic field 'B' and moved with velocity 'V' perpendicular to the field. The induced e.m.f is equal to the rate of change of magnetic flux, which is equal to the cross product of magnetic field and velocity vector and proportional to the length of the rod and depends on the sin of the angle between the B and V. Thus, e = BlV sinθ.

If the ratio of the amplitudes is not equal to 1, the trajectory will be an ellipse. If the ratio of the amplitudes is equal to 1. The trajectory will be a circle. • Since the force in this case would have led to S.H.M. of unequal amplitude, the ratio of the amplitude is not equal to 1 (especially less than 1). • Therefore, the trajectory of the resultant motion of the particle will be an ellipse. So option (a) is right.

Peltier discovered that when current is made to flow through a circuit consisting of two different types of conductors, a heating or cooling effect is observed at the junctions between the two materials this change in temperature at the junction is called the Peltier effect. When electric current is passed through a circuit consisting of two different conductors, a cooling effect is observed in one junction wheareas another junction experience a rise in temperature. This effect is reversible in nature and heating or cooling effect observed at a junction can be reversed by changing the direction of the current flow. Peltier effect is used for cooling computes and other electronic equipment.

questions.explanation_english: If the points in an electric field are all at the same electric potential, they are known as the equipotential points, on a surface collectively called as equipotential surface. • Electric field is always perpendicular to equipotential surface. • Two-equipotential surfaces can never intersect each other. • For a point charge, the equipotential surfaces are concentric spherical shells. • For a uniform electric field, the equipotential surfaces are planes normal to the X-axis. • For an electric dipole, equipotential surface is the plane perpendicularly bisecting the line joining the charges. • In a uniform electric field, any plane normal to the field directions an equipotential surface. • E ∝ 1 dr or E = dV – dr • For an infinitely long linear charge, equipotential surface are cylindrical.

questions.question_english: A rod of length l is placed in a uniform magnetic field of induction B. The rod is moved with velocity V as shown. Find the e.m.f induced across the rod.
questions.question_hindi: लंबाई त् की एक छड़ प्रेरण ँ के एक समरूप चुबकीय क्षेत्र में स्थित है। छड़ वेग न्न् से अग्रसर होती है जैसा कि निम्नांकित चित्र में दर्शाया गया है। संपूर्ण छड़ में प्रेरित विद्युत् वाहक बल (ई़ एम़ ए़फ) ज्ञात करें।
questions.explanation_english: When a rod is moving in a magnetic field then an e.m.f is generated across its ends. The e.m.f is given by e.m.f generated = BlVsinθ. • When a metal rod of length 'l' is placed normal to a uniform magnetic field 'B' and moved with velocity 'V' perpendicular to the field. The induced e.m.f is equal to the rate of change of magnetic flux, which is equal to the cross product of magnetic field and velocity vector and proportional to the length of the rod and depends on the sin of the angle between the B and V. Thus, e = BlV sinθ.
